cards.ex: I'm just trying to soak it all up while I'm here at the conference.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki konferensiyada ekanman, hamma narsani singdirib olishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ma'lumotni oson va tez qabul qilib, tushunib olmoq.

cards.ex: I need some time to mull over your proposal before I make a decision.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin sizning taklifingizni o'ylab ko'rishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani chuqur va uzoq vaqt davomida o'ylamoq, fikrlamoq.

cards.ex: The professor picked my essay apart, but it helped me improve.
cards.exUz: Professor mening inshomni tanqid qildi, lekin bu menga yaxshilanishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning har bir detalini tanqidiy ko'rib chiqib, kamchiliklarini topmoq.

cards.ex: I'm finding it hard to get my head around this new software.
cards.exUz: Men ushbu yangi dasturni tushunishga qiynalyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror murakkab narsani tushunishga harakat qilmoq, anglamoq.

cards.ex: I learned the hard way that you can't trust everyone.
cards.exUz: Men har kimga ishonib bo'lmasligini qiyin yo'l bilan o'rgandim.
cards.uzDef: Xatoliklar va qiyinchiliklar orqali saboq olmoq.

cards.ex: That documentary really gave me some food for thought.
cards.exUz: Ushbu hujjatli film menga o'ylash uchun sabab berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylashga, muhokama qilishga arziydigan narsa.

cards.ex: It's important to stay on top of the latest research in your field.
cards.exUz: O'z sohangizdagi so'nggi tadqiqotlarni nazoratda ushlab turish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani doimiy ravishda nazorat qilib, yangiliklardan xabardor bo'lib turmoq.

cards.ex: It took a while for the news to really sink in.
cards.exUz: Yangiliklarning haqiqatan ham ongimga singishi uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa tushunarli bo'lishi uchun vaqt kerak bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I'm trying to get to grips with the new accounting system.
cards.exUz: Men yangi buxgalteriya tizimini o'zlashtirishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunishni va undan foydalanishni o'rganmoq.

cards.ex: She has a natural flair for languages.
cards.exUz: Uning tillarga nisbatan tabiiy iste'dodi bor.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga tabiiy qobiliyatga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: It takes years to master a skill like playing the piano.
cards.exUz: Pianino chalish kabi mahoratni egallash uchun yillar kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror ko'nikmani yuqori darajada o'zlashtirmoq, mohir bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Let's cut to the chase – what's the bottom line?
cards.exUz: Keling, asosiy qismga o'taylik – yakuniy natija nima?
cards.uzDef: Batafsil ma'lumotlarni chetlab o'tib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri muhim narsaga o'tmoq.

cards.ex: Can you explain it in plain English, please?
cards.exUz: Iltimos, buni oddiy tilda tushuntirib bera olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Murakkab terminlarsiz, hammaga tushunarli bo'lgan tilda.

cards.ex: I heard it from the horse's mouth that the company is being sold.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya sotilayotganini ishonchli manbadan eshitdim.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri asl manbadan, ishonchli shaxsdan olmoq.

cards.ex: It's time to put your knowledge into practice.
cards.exUz: Bilimingizni amalda qo'llash vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: O'rganilgan bilim yoki ko'nikmani real vaziyatda ishlatmoq.

cards.ex: He's a walking encyclopedia when it comes to history.
cards.exUz: U tarixga kelsak, tirik ensiklopediya.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p ma'lumotga ega, bilimdon odam.

cards.ex: It takes a bit of practice, but you'll get the knack of it.
cards.exUz: Biroz mashq talab etiladi, lekin siz epini topasiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qanday qilishni oson va tez o'rganib olmoq.

cards.ex: I'm still trying to wrap my head around quantum physics.
cards.exUz: Men hali ham kvant fizikasini tushunishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror murakkab yoki yangi narsani tushunishga urinmoq.

cards.ex: If you're struggling, maybe you should go back to basics.
cards.exUz: Agar qiynalayotgan bo'lsangiz, balki asoslarga qaytishingiz kerakdir.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy tamoyillarga, sodda usullarga qaytib, boshidan boshlamoq.

cards.ex: I find I learn best by doing.
cards.exUz: Men amalda o'rganganimda eng yaxshi o'rganaman.
cards.uzDef: Nazariyadan ko'ra, amaliy tajriba orqali o'rganmoq.

cards.ex: They say you can't teach an old dog new tricks, but I disagree.
cards.exUz: Ular keksalarga yangi narsalarni o'rgatib bo'lmaydi deyishadi, lekin men bunga qo'shilmayman.
cards.term: teach an old dog new tricks
cards.uzDef: Katta yoshdagi odamga yangi narsalarni o'rgatish qiyin.

cards.ex: Keep in mind that the deadline is next week.
cards.exUz: Shuni yodda tutingki, oxirgi muddat kelasi hafta.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani esda saqlamoq, unutmaslikka harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Nobody likes a know-it-all.
cards.exUz: Hech kim hamma bilag'onni yoqtirmaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini hamma narsani biladigan deb hisoblaydigan odam.

cards.ex: You need to be able to think on your feet in this job.
cards.exUz: Bu ishda siz tez fikrlay olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tezda, kutilmagan vaziyatda aql bilan javob berish yoki qaror qabul qilish.

cards.ex: I'm planning to major in computer science.
cards.exUz: Men kompyuter fanlari bo'yicha mutaxassislik qilishni rejalashtiryapman.
cards.uzDef: Universitetda o'qiyotgan asosiy yo'nalishingizni tanlash.

cards.ex: I've been burning the midnight oil trying to finish this report.
cards.exUz: Men ushbu hisobotni tugatish uchun kechgacha ishlayapman.
cards.uzDef: Kechaning yarmini, yoki undan ham ko'proq qismini ishlashga sarflamoq.

cards.ex: I'm going to have to hit the books hard if I want to pass this exam.
cards.exUz: Agar men ushbu imtihondan o'tmoqchi bo'lsam, qattiq o'qishim kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Imtihon yoki topshiriqqa tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun juda ko'p o'qimoq.

cards.ex: I had a brainwave in the middle of the night about how to solve the problem.
cards.exUz: Tunda muammoni qanday hal qilish haqida birdaniga ajoyib fikrga keldim.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga ajoyib fikrga kelmoq.

cards.ex: I'm hoping to learn some Italian just by being in Italy – learning by osmosis!
cards.exUz: Men Italiyada bo'lish orqali italyan tilini o'rganishga umid qilaman – osmos orqali o'rganish!
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhit ta'sirida sezilmasdan o'rganmoq.

cards.ex: I need to get these ideas down before I forget them.
cards.exUz: Bu fikrlarni unutmasimdan oldin yozib olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani yozuv orqali saqlab qolmoq, qayd etmoq.
